OpenAI claims AI solved Millennium Prize math problem

Artificial intelligence company OpenAI claims its AI has solved the Navier-Stokes problem, one of seven Millennium Prize Problems established by the Clay Mathematics Institute. The problem, which has remained unsolved for over 200 years, is worth a $1 million prize. OpenAI stated that an AI developed by the company achieved the solution. However, the claim has reportedly led to a dispute over credit, with one report indicating concerns about how the solution was reached and whether data was potentially misused.
